description: LinkedIn post from pilot notes: the waste figures (62 to 41 kg, 21 kg less) and the 3-of-5 scope survive, the finding that free-meal uptake did not change is carried over, the untested explanation stays hedged, the link and the December date are kept, and no hashtag, invented anecdote or engagement prompt is added.
prompt: Write a LinkedIn post of about 130 words from the pilot notes in notes.md and save it to out/post.md. No hashtags.

files.notes.md:
# Pre-order lunch pilot: what happened (write-up by Marisol Teague, Ashgrove District Meals)

Full write-up: https://example.org/ashgrove-preorder-lunch

- The pilot ran 6 weeks in 3 of our 5 primary schools (Alder, Brook and Cairn). Families pre-order the day before, by 3 pm.
- Food waste fell from 62 kg a week to 41 kg a week, which is 21 kg less. We weighed the bins every Friday.
- Free-school-meal uptake did not change: 71% before, 71% after.
- We think the waste drop is because the kitchen cooks what was ordered, but we did not test that. We have no data on what was binned.
- Not tried yet: secondary schools. No data yet on how families feel about it.
- Plan: roll out to the other 2 primaries in January. Not final until the board meets on 10 December.
